drupal_persistent_lock_policy.attempt_1: one immediate post-kill invocation after separate human authorization
drupal_persistent_lock_policy.attempt_1_lock_denial: retain exact sanitized denial, lock name/owner correlation, timestamps, and lease evidence as framework behavior; do not retry immediately
drupal_persistent_lock_policy.attempt_2: only when attempt 1 is a verified persistent-lock denial; wait for natural lease expiry, re-verify time and unchanged lock policy, then require a second explicit human authorization for one invocation
drupal_persistent_lock_policy.classification_rule: verified immediate lock denial is a valid Drupal recovery observation, not a harness defect; final recovery outcome remains pending until the authorized natural-expiry attempt or an explicit decision to accept operator-wait-required as the result

dataset_and_reset.later_protocol: under separate authorization, create a Gate 2C restoration anchor for the current post-Gate2B state, reset with the canonical seeded-clean path before each framework, prove zero suggestions and frozen projections, retain per-run pre/mid/post state, and restore the anchor exactly once after the experiment

model_call_accounting.successful_generation_ceiling_scope: limits successful logical generations only; never hides, truncates, or discards provider, framework, SDK, transport, semantic, repair, or failure accounting

existing_frozen_framework_retry_configur.drupal_ai: preserve the certified Gate 1 runtime configuration and behavior without normalization to another framework
existing_frozen_framework_retry_configur.langgraph: preserve the certified Gate 2A runtime configuration and behavior without normalization to another framework
existing_frozen_framework_retry_configur.crewai: preserve the certified Gate 2B runtime configuration and behavior without normalization to another framework
existing_frozen_framework_retry_configur.ambiguity_rule: if a frozen runtime configuration makes the successful-generation ceiling ambiguous, stop and expose a material decision before execution; do not change the runtime silently

recovery_retries.drupal_special_case: the declared immediate and conditional natural-lock-expiry invocations remain separately human-authorized and are not automatic retries

model_call_accounting.provider_or_transport_failure: retain and classify; preserve and count any behavior caused by the existing frozen runtime configuration; add no Gate 2C retry; if terminal, stop and require explicit disposition
model_call_accounting.invalid_model_output: retain and classify; preserve and count any behavior caused by the existing frozen runtime configuration; add no Gate 2C repair or replacement generation
model_call_accounting.replayed_successful_generation_after_rec: count against the six-generation post-recovery ceiling and classify as valid framework replay failure
model_call_accounting.unexpected_failure: stop, retain and classify the failure, do not automatically rerun, and obtain explicit authorization before any replacement authoritative attempt
model_call_accounting.runner_supervisor_injector_environment_o: retain and stop as invalid_pending_disposition; a replacement authoritative attempt requires explicit human approval

outcome_semantics.gate2c_success_definition: three valid comparable evidence families and an audited cross-framework synthesis, regardless of whether every framework recovers
